svg.text: Assembly only. Up to 6 scanned neighbour genes per side in core orientation, coloured by homology group; red dashed outline = mobile-like neighbour skipped for host context. Conserved-end candidate = coding span + flank shared with all different-context copies (not an insertion boundary).
